en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing the ruins of a medieval stone castle with a large round tower and another conical‑roofed tower rising above partially collapsed walls. Forested countryside and scattered houses stretch into the distance. The lower border contains printed and handwritten captions, and there is a small printer's mark in the bottom‑right corner.
